title: Finite coefficient pullback comparison
statement: Let ell be prime, E a finite extension of Q_ell, f:X→Y any scheme map and n a natural number. The finite coefficient map ringMap ell E f (some n) is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Compare the chosen ringed-site adjunction with the constant-sheaf adjunction at the pro-etale terminal object; uniqueness of left adjoints identifies ringMap with an isomorphism component.

lean.statement: theorem coefficientPullback_some_isIso {X Y : Scheme.{t}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (n : ℕ) : IsIso (ringMap ell E f (some n))
